mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_request (requester_id, responder_id, intro_message, status, created_at) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{responderId}, #{introMessage}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_request SET status = #{status}, responded_at = NOW() WHERE chat_request_id = #{chatRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_request WHERE responder_id = #{responderId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
